driver_design_review: GO for a bounded physical-field prototype and two N32 MAP fits; no production or uncertainty-calibration claim. Astra performs design and closure review under user exception.
goal_contribution: Replace ambiguous linear-density exports with explicit positive z=0 density and a common coordinate/observation model before extending CF4-informed surroundings to 1-2 cMpc/h and an LG-only 0.3 cMpc/h zoom hierarchy.
reference: https://arxiv.org/abs/0911.1407 (Poisson-lognormal reconstruction precedent, NOT exact replication or a guarantee of nonlinear/void recovery)

model.latent: N32 LCDM white-to-Gaussian transfer from existing PMWD-normalized code, with fixed cubic cell-average sinc window; no fitted power correction
model.physical_density: rho/rhobar = exp(g)/mean(exp(g)); discrete coarse-cell model, not an exact average of a fine lognormal density
model.velocity: 100*f*i*k/k^2 times g, with own-axis Nyquist derivative zero; approximate potential flow, NOT dynamically evolved nonlinear mass-weighted velocity
model.coordinates: All coarse fields at (i+0.5)*dx; CIC catalog read subtracts 0.5
model.tracers: nbar*exp(alpha)*rho^bias/mean(rho^bias), then GH2 RSD/FoG TSC and selection; nbar from published population priors, never observed totals
model.nuisance: 24 standardized parameters with existing priors: amplitude6, bias6, FoG6, selection2, velocity4
model.scope: Approximate z=0 model only: its nonlinear density spectrum is not the LCDM linear spectrum, and its Gaussian latent is not an IC. No time reversal is implemented.

inputs.selection: Only raw_selection_exposure from the base-program Phase_A_datum
inputs.CF4: Existing fixed-design geometry/error/BGc/holdout construction; discard observed vobs before generating mock velocities

PM_remap: Conservative positive trilinear shift of density AND momentum by +0.25 coarse cell per axis: legacy coarse origin3 -> target6 cMpc/h. This adds smoothing; not a fresh independent validation simulation.
mock_contract: New synthetic Poisson counts and Gaussian radial velocities with CF4 design. Matched nuisance=0. PM arm has independent field dynamics but the same coarse observation generator, so it tests field-model mismatch only, not independent tracer/RSD/selection systematics. Counts holdout=.2; velocity holdout uses frozen row mask. Holdout does not enter optimization.

optimizer.meaning: latent-coordinate MAP candidate, not posterior mean or credible intervals

measurements: truth vs fitted physical density/velocity and observed-support metrics
heldout log-score improvement over homogeneous baseline
saved 3D truth/reconstruction maps and one common-scale central slice
decision: Report numerical failures separately from poor recovery. No posterior/frontier promotion from two MAP cases, even if both fit. Finish this bundle and request user approval before any sampling, actual-data inference, resolution increase or IC work.
